source: CAIQ v4.0.2 (curated subset, with per-question retrieval guidance)

questions.question: Does the vendor enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative access to production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for MFA, 2FA, two-factor, WebAuthn, FIDO2, TOTP, Okta, Duo, conditional access, hardware keys, privileged access with factor. Any requirement of a second factor for admin/production access is YES.

questions.question: Are strong password policies (complexity, minimum length, rotation, reuse) enforced for user accounts?
questions.guidance: Look for password policy, minimum length (e.g., 12+ chars), complexity, rotation interval (e.g., 90 days), password history, reuse prevention, blocked common passwords.

questions.question: Are user access reviews performed on a defined cadence (e.g., quarterly)?
questions.guidance: Look for access review, entitlement review, user access recertification, periodic review, quarterly/semi-annual/annual review, access audit.

questions.question: Is access provisioning and deprovisioning tied to the HR onboarding and offboarding process?
questions.guidance: Look for onboarding, offboarding, termination, HR integration, deprovisioning procedure, access revoked upon separation, SLA for revocation, joiner/mover/leaver.

questions.question: Is role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege enforced across production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for RBAC, role-based access, least privilege, principle of least privilege, access granted on need-to-know, entitlement, authorization model.

questions.question: Are shared or generic accounts prohibited for production access?
questions.guidance: Look for shared account, generic account, service account policy, prohibition of shared credentials, unique accounts for individuals. If explicit controls require individual accountability, YES.

questions.question: Is privileged access logged, monitored, and reviewed?
questions.guidance: Look for privileged access management, PAM, admin activity logs, audit logs for admin actions, session recording, log review, SIEM, monitoring of admin.

questions.question: Is single sign-on (SSO) via SAML or OIDC used for corporate and SaaS applications?
questions.guidance: Look for SSO, single sign-on, SAML, OIDC, identity provider, IdP, Okta, Azure AD / Entra, Google Workspace SSO, federated authentication.

questions.question: Is customer data encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent strength?
questions.guidance: Look for encryption at rest, AES-256, AES-128, encrypted storage, encrypted volumes, EBS encryption, server-side encryption, SSE, KMS-managed keys, TDE (transparent data encryption).

questions.question: Is data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher?
questions.guidance: Look for TLS, TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3, HTTPS, SSL (older), encryption in transit, mTLS, in-transit encryption, certificates, encrypted channels.

questions.question: Are encryption keys managed in a hardware security module (HSM) or a dedicated key management service (KMS)?
questions.guidance: Look for HSM, hardware security module, KMS, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, CloudHSM, FIPS 140-2/3, dedicated key store, customer-managed keys (CMK).

questions.question: Are encryption keys rotated on a defined schedule?
questions.guidance: Look for key rotation, annual rotation, automatic rotation, key lifecycle, rotate every N months, scheduled rotation.

questions.question: Is customer data logically or physically segregated between tenants?
questions.guidance: Look for multi-tenancy model, tenant isolation, logical segregation, per-tenant encryption, row-level security, dedicated tenant schema, isolated namespaces.

questions.question: Is data classification defined and applied (e.g., public, internal, confidential, restricted)?
questions.guidance: Look for data classification, classification scheme, confidential / restricted / internal / public tiers, sensitivity labels, DLP classification, handling requirements by class.

questions.question: Is data retention governed by a documented retention policy?
questions.guidance: Look for data retention policy, retention period, N years retained, retention schedule, end-of-retention disposal, records retention.

questions.question: Are secure data disposal procedures defined for end-of-life storage media?
questions.guidance: Look for secure disposal, data destruction, media sanitization, NIST 800-88, cryptographic erasure, shredding, wiping, end-of-life media.

questions.question: Does the organization maintain a documented incident response plan?
questions.guidance: Look for incident response plan, IR plan, IRP, security incident procedure, documented IR playbook, incident management policy.

questions.question: Is the incident response plan tested at least annually via tabletop exercises or simulations?
questions.guidance: Look for tabletop exercise, IR simulation, IR drill, annual test, incident response test, red team exercise, purple team exercise.

questions.question: What is the customer notification SLA for confirmed security incidents affecting customer data?
questions.guidance: Look for notification SLA, breach notification, notify within N hours, 72 hours, without undue delay, GDPR 72-hour, customer notification timeline.

questions.question: Are security incidents logged in a centralized system with defined severity tiers?
questions.guidance: Look for centralized logging, SIEM, Splunk, Datadog, severity tiers (P0-P3 or Sev-1 to Sev-4), incident ticketing, logging platform, log aggregation.

questions.question: Is a 24x7 security operations capability or on-call rotation in place for incident response?
questions.guidance: Look for 24x7, 24/7, around-the-clock, SOC, security operations center, on-call rotation, pager duty, after-hours coverage, incident commander.

questions.question: Are post-incident root-cause analyses and forensic procedures documented?
questions.guidance: Look for RCA, root cause analysis, post-mortem, post-incident review, forensics, forensic procedures, blameless post-mortem, lessons learned.

questions.question: Does the organization maintain a documented business continuity plan (BCP)?
questions.guidance: Look for BCP, business continuity plan, continuity procedures, business impact analysis, BIA, continuity of operations.

questions.question: What is the documented recovery time objective (RTO) for tier-1 production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for RTO, recovery time objective, time to recover, restoration SLA, N-hour recovery, tier-1 RTO, target recovery time.

questions.question: What is the documented recovery point objective (RPO) for tier-1 production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for RPO, recovery point objective, data loss tolerance, backup frequency, N-minute RPO, point of data loss.

questions.question: Are disaster recovery (DR) drills performed at least annually with documented results?
questions.guidance: Look for DR drill, DR test, failover test, disaster recovery exercise, annual test, DR rehearsal, documented drill results.

questions.question: Are production backups encrypted and stored in a geographically separate location?
questions.guidance: Look for encrypted backups, offsite backups, geographically redundant, cross-region backup, secondary region, immutable backups, backup retention.

questions.question: Are authenticated vulnerability scans performed on a regular cadence across production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for vulnerability scanning, authenticated scan, weekly scan, monthly scan, Qualys, Tenable, Nessus, internal/external scanning, scanning cadence.

questions.question: Does the organization perform third-party penetration testing at least annually?
questions.guidance: Look for penetration test, pentest, third-party pentest, annual pentest, external security assessment, ethical hacking engagement, red team.

questions.question: What is the remediation SLA for critical-severity vulnerabilities in production systems?
questions.guidance: Look for remediation SLA, critical patched within N days, high severity SLA, CVSS-based SLAs, patching timeline for critical, time-to-fix.

questions.question: Is patch management centralized and tracked against defined SLAs?
questions.guidance: Look for patch management, patching process, patch deployment, centralized patching, monthly patching cycle, patch tracking, WSUS/SCCM/Ansible.

questions.question: Are security findings tracked to closure in a ticketing or GRC system?
questions.guidance: Look for findings tracked, Jira tickets, ServiceNow, GRC platform, closure tracking, findings remediation tracked, ticketing system, issue tracker.

questions.question: Is application security testing (SAST/DAST) integrated into the software development lifecycle?
questions.guidance: Look for SAST, DAST, SCA, static analysis, dynamic analysis, software composition analysis, secure SDLC, security in CI/CD, shift-left security.

questions.question: Has the vendor completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in the last 12 months?
questions.guidance: Look for SOC 2 Type II, SOC 2 Type 2, audit period, service organization report, AICPA, attestation, Type 2 covering period.

questions.question: Is the SOC 2 audit scope inclusive of all systems that process or store customer data?
questions.guidance: Look for audit scope, systems in scope, services covered, Trust Services Criteria, TSC, production systems included.

questions.question: Does the vendor maintain ISO/IEC 27001 certification?
questions.guidance: Look for ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISMS, information security management system, ISO certificate, statement of applicability.

questions.question: Does the vendor meet PCI DSS, HIPAA, or other applicable regulatory requirements?
questions.guidance: Look for PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, FedRAMP, GDPR, CCPA, applicable regulations, attestation of compliance, AoC.

questions.question: Are internal audits conducted on security controls at least annually?
questions.guidance: Look for internal audit, internal control review, annually reviewed, audit committee, periodic control testing, management audits.

questions.question: Is there a documented internal control framework aligned to SOC 2 TSC or NIST CSF?
questions.guidance: Look for control framework, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, SOC 2 TSC, COBIT, ISO control objectives, documented controls catalog.

questions.question: Are audit findings tracked to remediation with management sign-off?
questions.guidance: Look for audit findings, findings tracked, remediation plan, management response, corrective action, CAPA, finding closure.

questions.question: Does the vendor maintain a public list of sub-processors with access to customer data?
questions.guidance: Look for subprocessor list, sub-processor, third-party list, subprocessors published, trust page, DPA Annex, vendor registry.

questions.question: Are third-party vendors subject to a formal security risk assessment prior to onboarding?
questions.guidance: Look for third-party risk assessment, vendor risk management, TPRM, security review of vendors, onboarding due diligence, vendor questionnaire.

questions.question: Is a software bill of materials (SBOM) produced for each production release?
questions.guidance: Look for SBOM, software bill of materials, CycloneDX, SPDX, dependency manifest, release artifact inventory.

questions.question: Are third-party code dependencies scanned for known vulnerabilities (e.g., SCA tooling)?
questions.guidance: Look for SCA, software composition analysis, Snyk, Dependabot, WhiteSource, Mend, dependency scanning, CVE tracking for deps.

questions.question: Are contractual protections (e.g., data processing agreements, confidentiality) required for all third parties handling customer data?
questions.guidance: Look for DPA, data processing agreement, NDA, confidentiality clauses, contractual controls, flow-down obligations, third-party contracts.

questions.question: Are production systems hosted in data centers with physical security controls certified under SSAE 18 or ISO 27001?
questions.guidance: Look for AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud provider, SSAE 18, SOC 1/2/3 inherited, ISO 27001 data center, physical security, Tier III/IV, colocation.

questions.question: Are production and non-production environments logically or physically segregated?
questions.guidance: Look for environment segregation, prod/dev separation, isolated VPCs, separate accounts, staging vs production, no prod access from dev.

questions.question: Is infrastructure-as-code (IaC) used to provision and manage production resources?
questions.guidance: Look for Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible, infrastructure as code, IaC, declarative provisioning, GitOps for infra.

questions.question: Are network segmentation and firewall rules documented, reviewed, and approved?
questions.guidance: Look for network segmentation, firewall rules, security groups, NACLs, subnet isolation, firewall review, approved change management for rules.

questions.question: Are server, container, or VM images hardened per CIS benchmarks or an equivalent standard?
questions.guidance: Look for CIS benchmarks, hardened images, golden image, DISA STIG, baseline hardening, image baseline, CIS-compliant.
